title: Anthropic is burning gas to feed the AI boom
hook_text: Anthropic is burning gas for AI
script:
Anthropic filed its initial public offering S-1 paperwork with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday.
The filing exposes a heavy methane dependency required to power massive Anthropic generative AI data centers.
Anthropic acknowledges that data centers are becoming increasingly reliant on natural gas for electrical supply.
Competition for data center locations with adequate power availability has become extremely intense across the industry.
This reliance on fossil fuels introduces major climate risks as Anthropic compute demands continue to grow.
Would you buy shares in Anthropic while its data centers run on natural gas?
